instruction: A candid outdoor photograph in a medium shot captures a sunny park with green grass. Five children stand in a row with their arms around each other's shoulders. From left to right: the boy in the blue denim shirt (R5) smiles with his right arm raised; the boy in the yellow t-shirt (R1) wears glasses and smiles; the girl in the light blue dress (R6) wears a pink headband and smiles gently; the girl in the brown jumpsuit (R3) has curly hair and smiles; and the girl in the dark blue cardigan (R4) smiles warmly. They stand close together in a friendly group embrace. Warm, bright sunlight creates a soft backlit glow behind them.
elements: R5 is the child in the shoulder-linked group who raises his right arm
R1 is between R5 and R6 in the shoulder-to-shoulder embrace
R6 is between R1 and R3 in the shoulder-linked row
R3 stands shoulder-linked next to R6 and R4
R4 participates at one end of the shoulder-linked group next to R3
The group is outdoors in a sunny park with green grass

questions.element: R5 is the child in the shoulder-linked group who raises his right arm
